releases.body:
## What's Changed

### Features
- Expose Cursor's native Auto routing as an `auto` model (#32)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ephraimduncan/opencode-cursor/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-cursor-oauth/v/0.1.1

## What's Changed

### Fixes
- Rebuild conversation state per request and redirect native tools (#21, #22, #23, #29)
- Register cursor provider and models on opencode 1.18+ (#30)

### Docs
- Update install and tool flow for 0.1.0

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ephraimduncan/opencode-cursor/compare/v0.0.9...v0.1.0

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-cursor-oauth/v/0.1.0

### Bug Fixes

- Report real token usage and estimate model costs (#20)

## What's Changed
* fix: model discovery, fallback IDs, and conversation context persistence by @ephraimduncan in https://github.com/ephraimduncan/opencode-cursor/pull/19


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ephraimduncan/opencode-cursor/compare/v0.0.7...v0.0.8
